projects.name: ODESteer
projects.summary: Corresponding Paper: ODESteer: A Unified ODE-Based Steering Framework for LLM Alignment
highlights: Proposed a unified framework for activation steering in LLM alignment based on ODEs and barrier functions in control theory
Proposed a new steering method called ODESteer derived from our ODE-based unified framework

projects.name: VF-NODE
projects.summary: Corresponding Paper: Accelerating Neural ODEs: A Variational Formulation-based Approach
highlights: Proposed a kind of accelerating technique for Neural ODEs based on the variational formulation of ODEs
Significantly accelerated the training of Neural ODEs about 10 to 1000 times

projects.name: TaylorNet
projects.summary: Corresponding Paper: CAT: Interpretable Concept-based Taylor Additive Models
